checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: audit range 1->30 prefab override apply; make baseline rebase transactional with the library write

impact_assessment.why: apply_prefab_override updates instance baselines before the prefab library write. A failed write loses the override report even though the template was never updated.
impact_assessment.benefits: Failed override applies leave the editor report and baselines unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: apply_prefab_override failure path; dependency: prefab baselines; concurrency: session lock unchanged; state: baselines and prefab cache.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Snapshot baselines before the action, restore on failure, add a patched-write regression, and run the 6/6 gate.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Snapshot and restore instance baselines when apply_prefab_override or its library write fails; regression covers a patched write

handoff.state: transactional override apply and regression green

[1/3] Plan: audit range 1->33 reload caching, rollback and lock-aware refresh; close the new material-to-texture refresh edge

impact_assessment.why: Refresh now loads prefabs after non-prefabs, but a changed material that newly references a changed texture can still load before the texture because both are non-prefab and ordered by id.
impact_assessment.benefits: New material-to-texture edges resolve against the fresh texture without a second refresh pass.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: refresh order only; dependency: asset kinds; concurrency: synchronous; state: source fingerprints.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Prioritize textures before materials in ready-source ordering, add a loader-based new-edge regression, and run the 6/6 gate.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Order textures/meshes before materials before prefabs so new material-texture edges resolve first; regression uses a loader that starts referencing a changed texture
[3/3] Range 1->33 gate passes 6/6 with new material-texture edges resolved; checklists: passed

[1/3] Plan: audit range 1->36 prefab baseline scoping/edit persistence; make prefab override mapping tolerant of structural template edits

impact_assessment.why: Override reports and revert/apply use structural child-count mapping. Adding a child to a prefab hides existing child overrides until a refresh, even though baseline merge preserves them.
impact_assessment.benefits: The override panel and per-field actions remain usable immediately after adding or removing template nodes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: prefab override mapping only; dependency: node IDs and link prefixes; concurrency: session lock unchanged; state: report and revert/apply resolution.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add ID-prefix mapping that skips nested groups, add a structural-edit regression, and run the 6/6 gate.

[1/3] Plan: audit range 1->39 state-machine lifecycle, history/clipboard cleanup; map restore collisions to a 400

impact_assessment.why: State-machine restore raises FileExistsError when the original name is occupied, and editor_action only maps KeyError/TypeError/ValueError, so clients receive a 500 for a normal collision.
impact_assessment.benefits: Restore collisions become actionable client errors instead of server failures.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: state-machine restore failure path; dependency: library_trash collision check; concurrency: session lock unchanged; state: trash/live files.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Catch FileExistsError in the action, add a collision regression, and run the 6/6 gate.

[1/3] Plan: audit range 1->42 clipboard, layer and registry reload fixes; reject missing same-name state-machine rename

impact_assessment.why: StateMachineLibrary.rename returns an error entry when source and target are the same missing name instead of raising KeyError, so the editor silently succeeds on a missing machine.
impact_assessment.benefits: Same-name rename now has the same missing-entry behavior as every other library operation.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rename failure path; dependency: .kstate files; concurrency: session lock unchanged; state: no file changes.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Check source existence before the same-name shortcut, add a library regression, and run the 6/6 gate.
